description: Provides an in-depth foundation in artificial intelligence paradigms, state-space search, constraint satisfaction, adversarial gaming, knowledge representation, and automated planning.
learning_objectives: Formulate problem solving using uninformed, informed, and local heuristic search strategies.
Implement adversarial game search, minimax algorithms, and alpha-beta pruning techniques.
Model and solve complex Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSPs) with constraint propagation.
Apply knowledge representation using propositional/first-order logic and automated planning.
outline: Intelligent Agents: Agent architectures, environment types, rationality, PEAS specifications.
Search Algorithms: Uninformed search (BFS, DFS, UCS), Informed search (Greedy Best-First, A*, IDA*, SMA*), heuristic design.
Local Search & Optimization: Hill climbing, Simulated Annealing, Genetic Algorithms, Beam Search.
Adversarial Search: Game theory, Minimax algorithm, Alpha-Beta pruning, evaluation functions, stochastic games.
Constraint Satisfaction Problems (CSPs): Backtracking search, Forward checking, Arc consistency (AC-3), MRV/degree heuristics.
Knowledge Representation & Logic: Propositional logic, First-Order Logic (FOL), resolution refutation, forward/backward chaining, classical planning.
Lab Component: Practical implementation of AI search, game playing, and logic agents in Python.

books.title: Artificial Intelligence: Foundations of Computational Agents
books.author: David L. Poole, Alan K. Mackworth
